parsed.public_message: White remains neutral to all and will not strike first before t=450. After that, any stance change gets one full public turn of notice. If we are attacked, we respond the same turn. We hold Central Heights only. The lowland around the ridge is open to passage, and scouts that stay off the crest will not be hunted.

private_messages.Claude: Agreed on your terms: mutual no-first-strike through t=450, then rolling, ended only with one full public turn of notice. If we are attacked, we respond the same turn. Your scout may cross the centre lowland. Stay off the crest and the ridge stays quiet.
private_messages.GPT: Your rider may pass the northeast lowland toward (690,910) if it stays off the crest. Neutrality holds. I will not strike first before t=450, and after that only with one full public turn of notice. We will not come down after a scout.
private_messages.Gemini: Neutral holds. We stay on Central Heights and will not enter the West Plateau. I will not strike first before t=450; after that, one full public turn of notice. No scouts from us toward your side.

parsed.notes_to_self: T4 t=75. All neutral. I will not strike first before t=450; after that, 1 full public turn of notice. If attacked, set enemy the same turn. Claude accepted-style lock to t=450 then rolling. GPT and Gemini still on the old t=300 compact until they say otherwise. No sightings. Claude Little Hill, scout centre lowland ~666,589 (Gemini), off crest. GPT army ~740,610 ford, scout to 690,910 off ridge. Gemini West Plateau still, no scouts. Hold crest: pikes phalanx S 568,812; crete 545,855; volley 600,842; thessaly 508,832 watches W gap x320-480; odrysia 658,826 watches E gap x720-800; hero guards pikes. Cliff near z=780. Do not descend or chase. Ring hits ~210m around t=445. At t=400 take the empty gap inward under truce: pikes, archers behind, cav flank. Kill heroes, elephants, champions, ranged. 3200 vs 4000: avoid a fair open fight. After t=600 bank value. Shared intel unverified. Watch Gemini from t=275; they may notice a t=300 break.
parsed.explanation: Grok stays neutral and promises not to strike first before t=450, matching Claude's offer while the ring is still far from the Heights. The pikemen form a south-facing phalanx on the crest, both archer squads dress behind them, and the cavalry shift to the west and east lips of the plateau. Nothing leaves the high ground, and the passing scouts are left alone.
